hints.title: Shortest Distances to Target
hints.text: Calculate the shortest distance from every node to target node n using a shortest path algorithm starting at n.

hints.title: Direct Acyclic Graph Dependency
hints.text: A transition from u to v is valid only if dist[u] > dist[v], forming a directed acyclic graph.

hints.title: Memoized Path Counting
hints.text: Count paths from 1 to n via memoized depth search or dynamic programming ordered by descending distance.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Traversing paths without distance monotonicity leads to cycles and exponential paths.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dijkstra from target node creates a topological ordering allowing linear DP over edges.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate runs Dijkstra from destination n, then performs DAG DP with memoization.
